about: Quality engineering specialist focused on automation architecture, test strategy, and the intersection of AI with modern QA practices. I've built and maintained test systems for Fortune 500 organizations across web, mobile, API, and media pipelines — with hands-on depth in Playwright, Selenium, Appium, OTT/DRM validation, Media QC automation, and CI/CD integration. My current work explores how LLMs, vision models, and agentic tooling can reduce the cost of test creation and maintenance without sacrificing transparency or engineering control.

projects.title: Smart Playwright Protocol
projects.description: SPP is a protocol-driven workflow for AI-assisted Playwright automation — not just a framework, but a defined contract for how AI agents and engineers collaborate on test tasks. It enforces a fixed lifecycle (Select → Understand → Explore → Plan → Implement → Verify) using Markdown task files, verification gates, and Page Object best practices. The CLI manages task state, hands off structured prompts to AI assistants, and keeps every automation step explicit and reviewable. Currently at v2.0 with MCP server integration.

projects.title: Testing LLM Automation Engine
projects.description: An LLM + vision AI framework for Playwright that covers three distinct problems: generating TypeScript tests from DOM context, generating tests from screenshots using vision-capable models, and automatically healing failing specs. The self-healer runs a Monitor → Investigate → Reason → Act → Report pipeline, combining deterministic heuristics for fast error classification with LLM reasoning for ambiguous failures. Every repair produces a structured HealingDecision artifact with confidence score, diagnosis, code patch, and verification result — keeping the process auditable rather than opaque.
